Subject: Vendor registration + MSA redline questions

Hi Jonas —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our procurement team is ready to move Redwood through our vendor enrollment, but they need two things from us before they can complete the Ariba/Coupa registration:

1) A clean copy of the signed MSA (they requested to see the document we intend to sign)
2) A field mapping doc showing which PO/Invoice fields Redwood will populate for Ariba vs Coupa (we have different required attributes in each system)

I attached our vendor intake form so your ops team can confirm the fields. Also: are there any clauses in your current MSA that typically trigger a redline for health systems (data residency, breach notification timelines, or indemnity caps)? If you can share the redline path and a contact in legal to quick-turn this, that would help.

Proposed next step: share your marked-up MSA + a draft order form mapping by EOD Friday and we’ll loop in our procurement manager to schedule the Ariba onboarding.

Thanks,
Nicole

Procurement Lead, NovaMed Health

Subject: Re: Vendor registration + MSA redline questions

Nicole —

Appreciate the clear ask. Quick answers below and next steps.

- Attachments: I’m attaching a draft order form field-mapping for Ariba and Coupa (spreadsheet) that our onboarding team uses. It lists the PO attributes we can populate and the preferred field names for each portal.
- MSA: Legal is reviewing a limited set of redlines. Typical items we see from health systems are: data residency language (we can add region-specific processing commitments), breach notification SLA (48–72 hours preferred by customers, we try to align), and liability caps. Laura (cc’d) will lead the redline response and can target a turnaround of 48 hours on your priority items.

Can you confirm whether NovaMed requires Redwood to populate: PO number (vendor PO field), cost center, GL account, tax exempt flag, and invoice reference? We can map defaults but need to be explicit for Coupa custom fields.

Next steps I propose:
1) Laura will upload a marked-up MSA and a short redline cover note by 12/18.
2) I’ll share the Order_Form_Field_Mapping_Ariba_Coupa_20261216.xlsx now so your procurement team can validate.
3) Schedule a 30-min mapping call with your procurement and our onboarding by next week to validate Ariba vendor ID, punchout settings (if needed), and PO routing.

Attachment(s): Order_Form_Field_Mapping_Ariba_Coupa_20261216.xlsx

Thanks,

Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood MSA — marked changes and cover note

Nicole —

Per Jonas, attaching our marked-up MSA with comments. High level: we accepted the majority of your non-substantive edits; the primary commercial/legal points we’ve flagged are:

- Data processing & residency: we can commit to storing backups within US regions and sign a data processing addendum for PHI-handling customers.
- Breach notification: we can commit to notification within 72 hours with a narrow exception window for investigation; customer-requested 48 hours is escalatable to execs but not standard.
- Indemnity/liability: we proposed a mutual cap tied to fees paid in the prior 12 months and limited consequential damages.

Please see inline comments for exact language and an annotated cover note that highlights the three negotiation buckets above. If NovaMed has a required specific clause for e.g., security audit rights, flag it in reply and we’ll prioritize.

Attachment(s): Redwood_MSA_markedup_20261218.pdf

—
Laura Bennett
Head of Legal Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Alan Brooks <alan.brooks@novamed.com>

Cc: Nicole Tran <nicole.tran@novamed.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Dec 2026 08:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood MSA — marked changes and cover note

Jonas/Laura —

Thanks for the quick turn. A few clarifications from NovaMed procurement after reviewing your spreadsheet and the MSA redline:

1) Field mapping: we require these fields populated on PO creation: PO Number (Vendor_PO_Number), Bill-to Code (Cost_Center), GL Account, Tax Exempt (Y/N), Invoice Reference (External_Ref). For Coupa we also need Supplier_Site_ID and a custom attribute called "ClinicalDivision" (string).

2) Ariba ID / enrollment: NovaMed will issue an Ariba party ID once vendor enrollment is complete. Please confirm the exact EDI/PO XML schema Redwood will emit so our integration team can validate (we can accept a sample file).

3) Contract amendments: Procurement prefers the 48-hour breach notification. If that’s a hard no, we’ll present the proposed 72-hour with exec approval as a fallback.

We’ve attached a filled vendor intake form with our internal reference numbers.

Attachment(s): NovaMed_vendor_form_20261214.pdf

Regards,
Alan Brooks
Senior Procurement Manager, NovaMed Health
